profile.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1 and all three TCG helpers enabled

boundary_selection.reason: The full call includes stateful DMA/MMIO effects: native replay preserved all 35 CPU registers but did not reproduce access values or touched memory.
boundary_selection.selected_leaf_role: deterministic DSP work before the stateful handoff tail

verifier_extension.purpose: Allow a call boundary and its instrumented nested-code range to be specified independently.

conclusion: The 30,001-instruction leaf is a stable, deterministic replay boundary at two cursor positions and is the next accelerator candidate. The containing DMA handoff is not replayable as one transaction.
next_gate: Map the selected leaf's loop structure and memory topology, then implement a verifier-only clean-room candidate.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Only aggregate instruction, access, register-count, footprint, and boundary-address results are committed. No Elektron firmware, project data, sample names, PCM, runtime values, runtime trace, or instruction bytes are committed.
